description: A registry's published catalog — the list of installable modules one source offers. It is UNTRUSTED data: publishing a module here says nothing about who made it. An install reads a manifest only from a registry DID the tenant accepts (grill 8r3q R4), then verifies the module's own publisher-signed release (ing.lexicon.plugin.release). One shape across ordered sources (signed registry / tenant override / user config), merged by `readRegistry` in @eoa/plugin-host.

main.description: The registry's manifest: one per registry repo. A catalog lists modules; it does not vouch for them.

modules.description: The modules this source offers. Embedding the entries makes a manifest a self-contained snapshot, so a catalog cannot be swapped out from under a reader.

module.description: One installable bundle. `cid` is the pin; a reader may opt into following the publisher's head instead (grill 8r3q R3).

cid.description: The bundle CID this entry is pinned to.

url.description: Where the bundle is fetched from, when it is not resolved by CID alone.
